Subject: Post-discovery recap + pick a 30‑min intro slot (LedgerAI)

Hi Megan / Tom —

Thanks again for the 30‑minute discovery today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we can align calendars: 

Key takeaways
- Primary use case: near-real-time inference for document ingestion pipeline (90–120ms p95 currently unacceptable)
- Volume: ~6–10M tokens/day across bursty processing windows (end of month peaks)
- Constraints: strict data residency for logs, SSO via Okta, and a need for observability into per-route cost.

What a successful 30‑minute intro looks like
1) Short demo of Redwood’s hosted + Dedicated routing options and expected p95 figures for similar workloads
2) Quick ops checklist (networking, KMS, retention) to validate Private deployment fit
3) Confirm next owners and a mutual action plan (MAP) to get a pilot running in 6–8 weeks

Proposed 30‑minute slots (please pick one or suggest alternates):
- Tue 6/22, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
- Wed 6/23, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Thu 6/24, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

I’ve attached a short one‑pager that frames the agenda and relevant artifacts (redwood-30min-brief.pdf). Ben (cc’d) will lead the demo; Karthik will cover ops/privileged deployment questions.

If you prefer, you can pick a slot on your side here: https://cal.com/ledgerai/30

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

—
